name: Rankmira – AI SEO Plugin with Schema, Sitemap & Google Search Console
author: wpazleen

sections.description:
Rankmira is a complete WordPress SEO plugin that helps your posts, pages and products rank higher in Google, Bing and AI search. It gives every post a live SEO score with 41 checks, writes SEO titles and meta descriptions with AI, builds rich result schema, generates your XML sitemap, manages redirects and 404s, finds internal link opportunities, and shows your Google Search Console and Analytics 4 data inside WordPress.

Search is changing. People now find content through ChatGPT, Perplexity, Gemini and Claude as well as Google. Rankmira covers both: classic on-page and technical SEO, plus AI search visibility with llms.txt, AI crawler control and AI referral traffic tracking. It also ships a built-in MCP server, so AI agents such as Claude, Cursor and VS Code can audit and improve your site’s SEO under rules you control.

Switching is painless. A one-click importer moves your titles, descriptions, focus keywords, robots settings, social data and redirects from Yoast SEO, Rank Math, All in One SEO, SEOPress and others. Your old data is never changed or deleted.

✨ Key Features

  • Live SEO score with 41 checks across Basic SEO, Additional, Title Readability and Content Readability. The same rules run in the editor and on the server.
  • Focus keyword plus up to four secondary keywords with density, placement, subheading, alt text and keyword reuse checks
  • Google snippet preview for desktop and mobile, with character counters and variable chips
  • AI SEO writer for titles, meta descriptions, keywords, social copy and FAQs, using OpenAI, Claude, Gemini, OpenRouter or a local model (Ollama, LM Studio). A built-in offline engine works with no API key.
  • Optimize to 90+ with one click: see every change before it is applied, and undo it later
  • AI Content Studio for content briefs, outlines, block-based drafts and bulk metadata
  • Schema markup with a connected graph and 24 types including Article, Product, FAQPage, HowTo, Recipe, Event, LocalBusiness, JobPosting, Course and VideoObject
  • Custom Schema Builder with templates, ACF, Pods and Meta Box fields, and display rules
  • XML sitemap with image entries, a readable stylesheet and an HTML sitemap shortcode
  • Redirect manager (301, 302, 307, 410, 451), 404 monitor and automatic redirects when a slug changes
  • Internal linking suggestions, orphan page finder and a broken link checker with one-click repair
  • Google Search Console and Google Analytics 4 inside WordPress: clicks, impressions, CTR, position, top queries, rank tracking and content decay
  • Core Web Vitals monitoring with Google PageSpeed Insights
  • AI search visibility: llms.txt, AI crawler blocking (GPTBot, ClaudeBot, PerplexityBot and more), AI referral traffic and AI revenue by platform
  • IndexNow instant indexing for Bing, Yandex and other participating search engines
  • Table of Contents, FAQ and How-To blocks with schema
  • Local SEO, WooCommerce SEO, breadcrumbs, image SEO and robots.txt editor
  • Site audit with a 0 to 100 score and one-click fixes
  • Bulk SEO editor, duplicate and thin content reports
  • MCP server with 34 tools and per-action safety switches for AI agents
  • One-click migration from Yoast SEO, Rank Math, All in One SEO, SEOPress, ThinkRank, Squirrly, Slim SEO and SureRank
  • Lightweight front end: meta tags and schema are printed from saved data, and block assets load only where blocks are used

Content Analysis & SEO Score

  • 41 live checks: Basic SEO (11), Additional (16), Title Readability (5) and Content Readability (9)
  • The score you see in the editor is the score that is saved, because the editor and the server share the same rules
  • Focus keyword plus four secondary keywords
  • Keyword reuse warning when another post already targets the same keyword
  • Pillar (cornerstone) content with stricter checks
  • Google snippet preview for desktop and mobile with live character counters
  • Works in the block editor sidebar, in a metabox below the content, or both. Switch without reloading.
  • Classic editor metabox
  • Posts list SEO score column, score filter and Quick Edit for SEO title, description, focus keyword and robots
  • SEO fields for categories, tags and custom taxonomies
  • Elementor page settings include an SEO section. Bricks, Beaver Builder and Breakdance recalculate the score on save.

AI SEO Assistant

  • Connect OpenAI, Anthropic (Claude), Google Gemini, OpenRouter or any OpenAI-compatible endpoint, including Ollama, LM Studio, Groq and vLLM
  • Built-in offline engine for suggestions with no API key
  • Generate 5 SEO titles, 3 meta descriptions, keywords, social copy and FAQ pairs
  • Optimize to 90+ with a review screen before changes are applied and an undo log
  • AI Content Studio: content brief with outline, questions people ask, entities and link targets, turned into a draft made of real blocks
  • Metadata Studio to generate and review titles and descriptions for many posts at once
  • Bulk AI queue with before and after view, approve or reject
  • Optional auto-fill of missing title, description and keyword on first publish (off by default)
  • Spend guard: daily request cap, per-minute limit and pause-all switch
  • Usage log with tokens and estimated cost
  • API keys are encrypted in your database

Schema Markup & Rich Results

  • Connected schema graph: WebSite, WebPage, Organization or Person, Article and BreadcrumbList
  • 24 schema types per post: Article, BlogPosting, NewsArticle, Product, Recipe, Course, Event, JobPosting, Book, SoftwareApplication, VideoObject, AudioObject, FAQPage, HowTo, QAPage, Service, Review, Person, LocalBusiness, Restaurant, Movie, MusicAlbum, Dataset and WebPage
  • Custom Schema Builder with templates, nested properties and values from post fields, custom fields, ACF, Pods and Meta Box
  • Display rules that decide where each schema template applies
  • Paste your own JSON-LD or import it from a URL
  • Live JSON-LD preview, Google rich result rule checks and a link to the Rich Results Test
  • WooCommerce product schema with price, stock, SKU, GTIN, MPN, brand, ratings, reviews, shipping and returns

SEO Blocks

  • Table of Contents: heading levels, excluded headings, rename and reorder, list styles, collapsible, sticky, active heading highlight, smooth scroll
  • FAQ: accordion or list, images, styles and FAQPage schema
  • How-To: steps with images, total time, supplies, tools, cost and HowTo schema
  • Scripts and styles load only on pages that use a block
  • Table of Contents, FAQ and How-To blocks from Rank Math and ThinkRank keep working and are converted

XML Sitemap, Robots.txt & Indexing

  • XML sitemap index with a sitemap for every post type and taxonomy
  • Image entries and a readable XSL stylesheet
  • WordPress core sitemap redirected to the Rankmira sitemap
  • HTML sitemap shortcode and a locations KML feed
  • Virtual robots.txt editor
  • IndexNow: URLs are sent to participating search engines when you publish or update, with manual submission and a log
  • Noindex control for post types, search results, paged archives, empty archives, attachments and thin author pages
  • Canonical URL per post, RSS feed footer and ?replytocom redirect

AI Search Visibility

  • llms.txt and llms-full.txt for AI assistants
  • One switch blocks GPTBot, ChatGPT-User, ClaudeBot, Claude-Web, PerplexityBot, CCBot, Google-Extended, Bytespider, Diffbot, FacebookBot, cohere-ai and Omgilibot, and sends a noai, noimageai header
  • AI referral traffic from ChatGPT, Perplexity, Claude, Gemini, Copilot, Grok and more
  • AI crawler hit log
  • WooCommerce orders and revenue by AI platform
  • Counted on your own server with no third-party script

Redirects & 404 Monitor

  • 301, 302, 307, 410 and 451 redirects with loop protection and hit counts
  • 404 log with one-click “turn into redirect”
  • Automatic 301 redirect when a published post’s slug changes
  • Redirect import from other SEO plugins and the Redirection plugin

Internal Linking & Broken Links

  • Link index with inbound, outbound and internal counts for every post
  • Internal link suggestions in the editor with one-click insert, favouring pillar pages
  • Orphan page finder
  • Daily broken link checker with repair: change the URL, remove the link or create a 301
  • External link rules: new tab, nofollow, noopener, sponsored domains, allow and deny lists

Google Search Console, Analytics 4 & Rank Tracking

  • Connect Google Search Console and Google Analytics 4 with read-only access
  • Clicks, impressions, CTR, average position and top queries
  • Low-CTR opportunities to improve
  • Rank tracker, content decay report, indexing log and URL inspection
  • Focus Pages board for your most important pages
  • Core Web Vitals history with Google PageSpeed Insights
  • Alerts by email, Slack or Discord for a noindex homepage, a robots.txt that blocks everything and 404 spikes

Social Media SEO

  • Open Graph and X (Twitter) cards with site defaults and per-post title, description and image
  • Facebook app ID and admins
  • Profile links for Facebook, Instagram, TikTok, YouTube, LinkedIn, Pinterest and WhatsApp Business, added to schema as sameAs
  • Site verification for Google, Bing, Yandex, Baidu, Pinterest and Facebook

Image SEO

  • Missing alt and title attributes filled from templates. An alt text you wrote is never overwritten.
  • Media Library scanner with batch “fill missing alt” and optional AI alt text

Site Audit & Bulk SEO Tools

  • Site audit with a 0 to 100 score, 13 checks and one-click fixes
  • Bulk snippet editor with filters
  • Content type matrix for indexing, default schema and sitemap per post type
  • Duplicate title and description report and thin content report
  • Recalculate all SEO scores at once

Local SEO, WooCommerce SEO & Breadcrumbs

  • Business details, opening hours, multiple locations, map, LocalBusiness schema and KML feed
  • Shortcodes: [rankmira_location], [rankmira_hours], [rankmira_map]
  • WooCommerce: noindex for cart, checkout and account pages, product title variables, brand support, product schema, generator tag removal and product category base removal with redirects
  • Breadcrumbs with BreadcrumbList schema through [rankmira_breadcrumbs] or rankmira_breadcrumbs()

Titles & Meta Templates

  • Title and meta description templates for every post type, taxonomy, author, date, search and 404 page
  • More than 60 variables, and your own with rankmira_register_variable()

MCP Server for AI Agents

Rankmira includes a Model Context Protocol (MCP) server, so Claude Code, Claude Desktop, Cursor, VS Code, Codex and Windsurf can work on your site’s SEO. Its 34 tools can find, read, create, edit, trash and restore content; audit and update SEO fields; run AI optimization; find and replace; manage media and alt text; manage redirects; compare changes; and undo.

  • One master switch, plus a separate switch for each kind of change
  • Media delete and raw site settings changes are off by default
  • Publishing mode: publish directly, or force every change to a draft
  • Choose which post types an agent can touch
  • Confirmation tokens, a log of every change and snapshots with undo
  • Rate limit (120 requests a minute by default), upload size cap and a built-in self-test
  • Sign in with WordPress Application Passwords or Rankmira access tokens with optional expiry
  • Ready-made connection snippets for each client

For Agencies & Developers

  • Role Manager with a capability matrix
  • Headless SEO: an endpoint that returns head HTML and schema for any URL, and HMAC-SHA256 signed webhooks
  • WP-CLI: wp rankmira score-recalc, sitemap-generate, redirects, audit-run, links-scan, import and settings
  • REST API under rankmira/v1, template functions and filters
  • Multilingual SEO: WPML, Polylang and TranslatePress with hreflang and x-default
  • Full JSON backup and restore of settings, redirects and SEO data

🎯 Perfect For

  • Bloggers who want a clear checklist for every post
  • Content teams who need AI help writing titles and descriptions at scale
  • WooCommerce stores that want product rich results and AI revenue tracking
  • Local businesses that need LocalBusiness schema and location pages
  • Agencies managing many sites with WP-CLI, roles and backup and restore
  • Developers building headless sites or connecting AI agents through MCP
  • Anyone switching from Yoast SEO, Rank Math, All in One SEO or SEOPress

External Services

Rankmira contacts outside services only when you turn on the feature that needs them. It has no telemetry and does not track you or your visitors.

AI providers (optional)

If you add an API key, the text you ask the AI to work on (for example a post’s title and content, or an image’s file name and nearby text) is sent to the provider you choose. Nothing is sent without a key. Used by the editor AI tab, AI Content Studio, bulk AI, auto-fill on publish, Media Library alt text and the MCP AI tools.
* OpenAI: https://api.openai.com — Terms: https://openai.com/policies/terms-of-use | Privacy: https://openai.com/policies/privacy-policy
* Anthropic: https://api.anthropic.com — Terms: https://www.anthropic.com/legal/commercial-terms | Privacy: https://www.anthropic.com/legal/privacy
* Google Gemini: https://generativelanguage.googleapis.com — Terms: https://ai.google.dev/gemini-api/terms | Privacy: https://policies.google.com/privacy
* OpenRouter: https://openrouter.ai — Terms: https://openrouter.ai/terms | Privacy: https://openrouter.ai/privacy
* A custom OpenAI-compatible endpoint: the address you enter, which can be a server on your own network.

Google sign-in, Search Console and Analytics 4 (optional)

When you connect Google, Rankmira signs in with Google and reads Search Console and Analytics data (read-only) from https://accounts.google.com, https://oauth2.googleapis.com, https://www.googleapis.com, https://searchconsole.googleapis.com, https://analyticsadmin.googleapis.com and https://analyticsdata.googleapis.com. URL inspection sends URLs of your own site. Tokens are stored encrypted, and disconnecting revokes the token. If the site sets an OAuth relay (the rankmira_google_oauth_relay filter or RANKMIRA_GOOGLE_OAUTH_RELAY constant), the one-click sign-in uses that relay address. No relay is set by default.
Terms: https://policies.google.com/terms | Privacy: https://policies.google.com/privacy

Google PageSpeed Insights (optional)

The Core Web Vitals page sends the URLs you track to https://www.googleapis.com/pagespeedonline/v5/runPagespeed when you run a test, and weekly if the schedule is on.
Terms: https://policies.google.com/terms | Privacy: https://policies.google.com/privacy

IndexNow (on by default)

When you publish or update a page, its URL and your IndexNow key are sent to https://api.indexnow.org/indexnow, which shares them with participating search engines. Turn off the Instant Indexing module to stop it.
About: https://www.indexnow.org/ | Privacy: https://www.bing.com/indexnow/privacy

Webhooks you set (optional)

Alerts post to the Slack or Discord webhook address you enter. Headless webhooks post signed change notices to the address you enter. Only addresses you provide are used.

Links in your content

The broken link checker requests each external link found in your content to see if it still works. The schema “import from URL” tool and the MCP “upload media from URL” tool fetch only the address you give them, with protection against requests to private addresses.

All other features (analysis, schema, sitemaps, redirects, llms.txt, AI bot rules and AI referral counting) run on your own server.

Source Code

The human-readable source for all compiled JavaScript and CSS in the build/ folder is included in the plugin’s src/ folder.

Build instructions:

  1. Run npm install to install dependencies.
  2. Run npm run build to compile the JavaScript and CSS with @wordpress/scripts.
  3. Compiled files are written to build/, matching what ships in the plugin.

Competitor Analysis

Search the WordPress plugin directory for an SEO plugin and the same few names come up: Yoast SEO, ThinkRank SEO – AI SEO Plugin for SEO & Google Search Console, Rank Math, All in One SEO and SEOPress. All are mature, widely trusted tools, and each is a …
sections.installation:
You can install Rankmira from your WordPress dashboard or manually.

  1. Install the plugin:

– In your WordPress admin, go to Plugins > Add New, search for “Rankmira”, then click Install Now.
– Or upload the rankmira folder to the /wp-content/plugins/ directory.

  1. Activate the plugin from the Plugins screen. The setup wizard opens.

  2. Run the setup wizard:

– Pick your site type.
– Choose what goes into the XML sitemap.
– Import your data from your old SEO plugin if you had one.

  1. Open Rankmira in the admin menu for the dashboard, settings and SEO tools.

  2. Edit any post and open the Rankmira sidebar to see its SEO score.

  3. Optional: add an AI API key in Settings > AI and Providers, and connect Google in Settings > Search Console & GA4.
sections.faq:
What is Rankmira?

Rankmira is a WordPress SEO plugin that helps your content rank in Google and AI search. It gives each post a live SEO score, writes titles and meta descriptions with AI, adds schema markup, builds your XML sitemap, manages redirects, suggests internal links and shows your Search Console data inside WordPress.

How is Rankmira different from Yoast SEO?

Yoast SEO’s free version gives each post one focus keyphrase and offers the redirect manager and internal linking suggestions in Yoast SEO Premium. Rankmira gives each post a focus keyword plus four secondary keywords and includes redirects, a 404 log, internal link suggestions, broken link repair, Search Console data, AI writing and an MCP server in the same plugin.

Is Rankmira a good Rank Math alternative?

Yes. Rankmira covers multiple keywords, schema, redirects, a 404 monitor and Search Console like Rank Math does. Its AI works with your own OpenAI, Claude, Gemini, OpenRouter or local model key instead of a credit system, and it converts Rank Math’s Table of Contents, FAQ and How-To blocks when you switch.

How does Rankmira compare to All in One SEO and SEOPress?

Both are solid plugins. Redirects, link tools and Search Console features are part of their paid plans. Rankmira includes them, plus AI search visibility tools (llms.txt, AI crawler control and AI referral tracking) and a built-in MCP server for AI agents.

Can I move from Yoast SEO, Rank Math, All in One SEO, SEOPress or another SEO plugin?

Yes. The setup wizard (and the Tools page) imports titles, descriptions, focus keywords, robots settings, canonical URLs, social fields and redirects in batches from Yoast SEO, Rank Math, All in One SEO, SEOPress, ThinkRank, Squirrly, Slim SEO and SureRank. A separate importer reads the Redirection plugin. Your old data is left as it is. Global settings such as title templates are not imported yet, so check Settings > Site Identity > Title Formats after you switch.

Will I lose my SEO rankings when I switch?

Not from the move itself. Your titles, descriptions, canonical URLs, robots settings and redirects are imported, so search engines keep seeing the same signals. Rank Math and ThinkRank Table of Contents, FAQ and How-To blocks are converted. Yoast FAQ and How-To blocks are still read for schema, but they are not converted to Rankmira blocks.

Can I keep my old SEO plugin active while I test?

Yes. While another SEO plugin is active, Rankmira does not print its own head tags, so your pages never get two sets of meta tags or schema. A notice offers to deactivate the old plugin with one click.

Do I need an AI API key?

No. Without a key, a built-in engine gives simple suggestions on your own server. With a key from OpenAI, Anthropic, Google Gemini, OpenRouter or a compatible endpoint, you get model-written titles, descriptions, briefs and fixes.

Can I use a local AI model like Ollama?

Yes. Any OpenAI-compatible endpoint works, including Ollama, LM Studio, Groq and vLLM. With a local model your content never leaves your network.

What happens to my API key and my data when I use AI?

Keys are encrypted before they are saved. When you use an AI feature, only the text needed for that task is sent to the provider you picked. You can set a daily request cap and a per-minute limit, and pause all AI with one switch.

How much will AI cost me?

Only what your AI provider charges for your own key. Rankmira shows tokens and estimated cost in Settings > AI and Providers > Usage, and the spend guard lets you cap requests.

What is the MCP server and how do I connect Claude?

MCP (Model Context Protocol) is a standard that lets AI tools work with your site. Go to Rankmira > MCP Server, create an access token, and copy the ready-made setup for Claude Code, Claude Desktop, Cursor, VS Code, Codex or Windsurf. The address is /wp-json/rankmira-mcp/v1/mcp.

Is it safe to let an AI agent change my site?

You stay in control. A master switch turns the server off. Every kind of change has its own switch, and deleting media and changing site settings are off by default. You can force all agent changes to be saved as drafts, limit which post types an agent can reach and require confirmation. Every change is logged and can be undone from a snapshot. Only users who can edit posts can connect.

Can I use ChatGPT or another client instead of Claude?

Any client that supports MCP over HTTP can connect with the same address and an access token or Application Password. Browser-based OAuth sign-in for MCP is not available yet.

How do I connect Google Search Console and Google Analytics 4?

Go to Settings > Search Console & GA4, create a Google Cloud OAuth client, paste its client ID and secret, and press Connect. Access is read-only. Rankmira does not add the GA4 tracking tag to your pages.

What schema types does Rankmira support?

24 types per post, including Article, BlogPosting, NewsArticle, Product, Recipe, Course, Event, JobPosting, FAQPage, HowTo, LocalBusiness, Review, VideoObject and SoftwareApplication. The Custom Schema Builder lets you build any other type from templates and custom fields.

Does it create an XML sitemap?

Yes. Rankmira serves its sitemap at /sitemap_index.xml and redirects WordPress’s default /wp-sitemap.xml to it. You choose which post types and taxonomies are included. Posts and terms set to noindex are left out. Submit the sitemap address in Google Search Console.

What are llms.txt and the AI bot switch?

llms.txt is a short Markdown file that points AI assistants to your key pages, and llms-full.txt adds page text. The AI bot switch adds Disallow rules for known AI crawlers to robots.txt and sends a noai, noimageai header. Robots.txt rules are requests that well-behaved crawlers follow.

Does it work with WooCommerce?

Yes. It adds product schema (price, stock, SKU, GTIN, MPN, brand, ratings, reviews, shipping and returns), product title variables, noindex rules for cart, checkout and account pages, brand support, and revenue by AI platform.

How do I add a Table of Contents, FAQ or How-To block?

In the block editor, click the plus button and open the Rankmira category. Each block has its own settings in the sidebar. The FAQ and How-To blocks add FAQPage and HowTo schema, which you can turn off per block.

Will it slow down my site?

No. The front end prints meta tags and schema from saved data. The analyzer runs in the editor, not for visitors. Block scripts load only on pages that use a block, and AI referral counting adds no tracking script. Heavy jobs such as broken link scans run in the admin or on a schedule.

Does it work with page builders and the classic editor?

Yes. The classic editor has its own metabox, Elementor has an SEO section in its page settings, and Bricks, Beaver Builder and Breakdance recalculate the score when you save. The analyzer reads the main post content, so text kept only in builder or custom fields is not counted yet.

Does it support multilingual sites?

Yes. WPML, Polylang and TranslatePress are detected and hreflang tags with x-default are added. The readability checks are written for English; all other checks work in any language.

Does it work on multisite?

Rankmira is built for single sites. Activate it on each site in a network where you need it. Network-wide settings are not available yet.

Can I manage redirects in bulk?

You can add, edit, disable and delete redirects in the admin, and import them from other plugins. Rules match exact paths. Regex rules and CSV import in the admin are not available yet.

Does it collect data about me or my visitors?

No. There is no telemetry and no usage tracking. AI referral and crawler counts are stored in your own database.

What is removed when I uninstall?

Nothing by default. If you turn on “Delete data on uninstall” (Settings > Data and Uninstall), Rankmira removes its settings, its post, term and user meta and the redirects table. Your posts are never touched.

Where do I get help?

Use the support forum on this plugin’s WordPress.org page. Include your WordPress version, PHP version and the steps that led to the problem.

MCP Server for AI Agents

Its 34 tools can find, read, create, edit, trash and restore content; audit and update SEO fields; run AI optimization; find and replace; manage media and alt text; manage redirects; compare changes; and undo.

  • One master switch, plus a separate switch for each kind of change

External Services

Rankmira contacts outside services only when you turn on the feature that needs them. It has no telemetry and does not track you or your visitors.

AI providers (optional)

If you add an API key, the text you ask the AI to work on (for example a post’s title and content, or an image’s file name and nearby text) is sent to the provider you choose. Nothing is sent without a key. Used by the editor AI tab, AI Content Studio, bulk AI, auto-fill on publish, Media Library alt text and the MCP AI tools.
* OpenAI: https://api.openai.com — Terms: https://openai.com/policies/terms-of-use | Privacy: https://openai.com/policies/privacy-policy
* Anthropic: https://api.anthropic.com — Terms: https://www.anthropic.com/legal/commercial-terms | Privacy: https://www.anthropic.com/legal/privacy
* Google Gemini: https://generativelanguage.googleapis.com — Terms: https://ai.google.dev/gemini-api/terms | Privacy: https://policies.google.com/privacy
* OpenRouter: https://openrouter.ai — Terms: https://openrouter.ai/terms | Privacy: https://openrouter.ai/privacy
* A custom OpenAI-compatible endpoint: the address you enter, which can be a server on your own network.

Google sign-in, Search Console and Analytics 4 (optional)

When you connect Google, Rankmira signs in with Google and reads Search Console and Analytics data (read-only) from https://accounts.google.com, https://oauth2.googleapis.com, https://www.googleapis.com, https://searchconsole.googleapis.com, https://analyticsadmin.googleapis.com and https://analyticsdata.googleapis.com. URL inspection sends URLs of your own site. Tokens are stored encrypted, and disconnecting revokes the token. If the site sets an OAuth relay (the rankmira_google_oauth_relay filter or RANKMIRA_GOOGLE_OAUTH_RELAY constant), the one-click sign-in uses that relay address. No relay is set by default.
Terms: https://policies.google.com/terms | Privacy: https://policies.google.com/privacy

Google PageSpeed Insights (optional)

The Core Web Vitals page sends the URLs you track to https://www.googleapis.com/pagespeedonline/v5/runPagespeed when you run a test, and weekly if the schedule is on.
Terms: https://policies.google.com/terms | Privacy: https://policies.google.com/privacy

IndexNow (on by default)

When you publish or update a page, its URL and your IndexNow key are sent to https://api.indexnow.org/indexnow, which shares them with participating search engines. Turn off the Instant Indexing module to stop it.
About: https://www.indexnow.org/ | Privacy: https://www.bing.com/indexnow/privacy

Webhooks you set (optional)

Alerts post to the Slack or Discord webhook address you enter. Headless webhooks post signed change notices to the address you enter. Only addresses you provide are used.

Links in your content

The broken link checker requests each external link found in your content to see if it still works. The schema “import from URL” tool and the MCP “upload media from URL” tool fetch only the address you give them, with protection against requests to private addresses.

All other features (analysis, schema, sitemaps, redirects, llms.txt, AI bot rules and AI referral counting) run on your own server.

Source Code

The human-readable source for all compiled JavaScript and CSS in the build/ folder is included in the plugin’s src/ folder.

Build instructions:

  1. Run npm install to install dependencies.
  2. Run npm run build to compile the JavaScript and CSS with @wordpress/scripts.
  3. Compiled files are written to build/, matching what ships in the plugin.
